facts.fact: StackAdapt placed 69th on G2's Top 100 Software Product list for 2020, according to the vendor's blog post.
facts.quote: StackAdapt, a software company providing digital advertising solutions, placed 69th on the [Top 100 Software Product](https://www.g2.com/best-software-companies/top-products) list

facts.fact: StackAdapt placed 10th on G2's Highest Satisfaction list for 2020, according to the vendor's blog post.

G2's Top 100 Software Product ranking was based on data from over 1 million authentic, verified customer reviews written and published between January 1, 2019 and March 3, 2020, spanning 77,381 software products.
facts.quote: G2 created the Top 100 Software Products based on data from over 1 million authentic, verified customer reviews.

facts.fact: G2 reported that it had over 57,844 software companies listed on its platform in 2020.
facts.quote: With over 57,844 software companies on G2,StackAdapt is honoured to be recognized

facts.fact: The 2020 G2 reviews used for the Top 100 ranking spanned 77,381 software products.
facts.quote: These reviews—each vetted by a real person to ensure legitimacy—spanned across 77,381 software products.

facts.fact: G2 CEO Godard Abel stated that G2 analyzes more than 4 million data points to determine which products and companies make the list.
facts.quote: G2 analyzes more than 4 million data points to determine which products and companies make the list.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's 2020 G2 list placement was its first time appearing on one of G2's Best Software lists.
facts.quote: This is StackAdapt’s 1st time on one of G2’s Best Software lists.

facts.fact: StackAdapt was launched in 2014, according to its co-founder and COO Vitaly Pecherskiy.
facts.quote: When we launched StackAdapt in 2014, we knew that the future of advertising lies in using software
